hypothesis: The creator's order makes the sum list the input of the next step: its numbers count back from the Architect's choice in the film scene and pick out letters or words.
source_support: Creator #3390 quotes the Scott Manning transcript at the line after the two doors (09 section 2).
operand: Lists: the ordinary cells as digits and the gap-sum lists of both parses (six lists). Texts: the two saved transcripts of the Architect scene, dialogue only. Anchors: each of the five occurrences of 'choice', the point just after 'to stop it', and the end of the scene.
operation: From an anchor, select by running sum or by direct index, counting from 0 or from 1, backward or forward, in units of letters or of words (taking the word's first or last letter). Each selection is kept as read and reversed.

predicted_artifact.detail: One selection is a readable sequence of at least 8 letters.

acceptance_rule: PASS if the best real quadgram score is above the maximum over 300 control runs (all lists shuffled, every configuration) and above -4.9; otherwise NULL. Whole selected words are not judged: they are always English words.

controls.planted: A step list constructed so that running back-steps over letters from the door anchor spell a 26-letter phrase must be read back exactly and score above every control maximum.
controls.null: 300 runs in which each list is shuffled and the whole family is recomputed; the maximum score of each run.
